description: React component for previewing and processing document chunks in a loader configuration interface, including API interactions, state management, and UI rendering.

methods.name: handleDocumentLoaderDataChange
methods.description: Updates selected document loader data and input parameters based on user input.

methods.name: handleTextSplitterDataChange
methods.description: Updates selected text splitter data and input parameters based on user input.

methods.name: onSplitterChange
methods.description: Handles change of selected text splitter from dropdown options.

methods.name: onChunkClick
methods.description: Opens a dialog to display expanded view of a selected document chunk.

methods.name: checkMandatoryFields
methods.description: Validates that all required input fields are filled before processing.

methods.name: onPreviewChunks
methods.description: Fetches and displays a preview of document chunks based on current configuration.

methods.name: onSaveAndProcess
methods.description: Saves the loader configuration and initiates processing, then redirects to document store.

methods.name: prepareConfig
methods.description: Prepares the configuration object for API requests based on current state.
